summary: Gujarat's tallest waterfall — a roughly 30 m plunge on the Gira river deep in interior Dang, thundering from July to October.
description:
Girmal is the waterfall Gira's crowds never see: a single hard plunge of roughly thirty metres on the Gira river near Girmal village, deep enough into interior Dang that even peak-monsoon weekends stay manageable. The drop is taller and tighter than Gira's broad curtain, and in August the plume of spray is visible before the deck comes into view.

A railed viewpoint faces the fall across the gorge — close enough for the mist to reach you in peak flow — and the drive itself is half the reward: forest roads through teak and bamboo, village fields, and ridgelines that stay green well into winter. This is the anchor stop of any interior-Dang loop, pairing naturally with Don hill or the Mahal campsite inside Purna sanctuary.

Flow is strictly seasonal. July–September is the spectacle, October still strong, and by February the river thins to a stream — worth knowing before committing to the long interior drive in the dry months.
highlights: Tallest waterfall in Gujarat at roughly 30 m
Railed viewing deck facing the plunge across the gorge
Rarely crowded even at monsoon peak
Forest drive through the heart of interior Dang

modes.road: Via Ahwa; the last stretch is a narrow forest road to Girmal village
modes.rail: Waghai (heritage narrow gauge); Bilimora Jn is the nearest broad-gauge railhead

access.last_mile: Motorable to the viewpoint gate; short paved walk to the deck
access.road_condition: Tarred but narrow interior roads; slow going in rain

visit.notes: Deck may close briefly after very heavy overnight rain.

seasonality.notes: Full flow July–September; still strong in October; reduces to a stream by late winter.

experience.photography_notes: Shoot before 10:00 for side-lit spray; carry a lens cloth — the deck sits in the mist zone in August.

amenities.food: Seasonal snack stalls at the parking lot; nearest reliable food is in Ahwa
amenities.guides: Not needed; the path is obvious

warnings: Do not cross the railing — rock faces are lethal when wet
No swimming at the base pool
Leech protection advised on grassy paths at monsoon peak

tips: Club it with Don hill or Mahal campsite to justify the interior drive
Fuel up in Ahwa — there are no petrol pumps on the interior stretch
October gives strong flow, easier roads and empty decks

faqs.q: Is Girmal Falls worth visiting outside monsoon?
faqs.a: October–November still has decent flow; by February it is a thin stream — go for the drive and the valley then, not the falls.

faqs.q: Girmal or Gira — which one should I pick?
faqs.a: Gira is bigger-crowd, five-minute-access; Girmal is taller, wilder and 90 minutes deeper into the hills. With a full day, do both; with an afternoon, Gira.

nearby.note: Pairs well for a full-day interior loop
